reviews.text: Justin worked on two of our productions and we couldn’t be happier with the results, but also with him as our temporary team member. With him, you book a videographer that will be your second brain throughout the project and not just only when asked. We can highly recommend you and your work, Justin, and are already looking forward to our next project.
reviews.name: Inken Weber

reviews.text: Justin has captured my back-to-basics canoe trekking in Sweden. And wow, the results are FAR beyond expectations. The movie, reels and pictures made, show exactly the atmosphere during the canoe trip. He really captured the essence of it. What I really liked about working with Justin is that he has the perfect mix of social and creative skills. He listens well, asks good questions, comes up with ideas and takes initiative and responsibility. Besides that, he’s just a really awesome person to have around. Professional, but definitely also kind, curious, fun and relaxed. We’re super grateful for his work for Roots Grow North, and love to keep working with Justin for our future events.
reviews.name: Stijn Klaren

reviews.text: What a great collaboration with our photographer Justin during the shoot at Julianatoren Children’s Amusement Park! From the very first moment, Justin was proactive, super flexible, and knew exactly how to capture the right moments. With so much energy and enthusiasm amidst all the children and attractions, it remains impressive how he stays calm and shoots the perfect photo time after time. The images radiate fun, spontaneity, and experience, exactly what Julianatoren is all about. A true professional whom we will continue to hire with confidence!
reviews.name: Jul de Muis

reviews.text: Justin helped us at the Drive For Life Foundation with beautiful footage during one of our drives. His professionalism shines through in the images; it is a pleasure working with him. We therefore hope that he will help us often in the future.
reviews.name: Marten
reviews.ctx: Drive For Life Foundation, on Google, translated from Dutch

reviews.text: Over the past few years Justin has handled several video and photography jobs for me. From the concept phase to the shoot, everything was taken care of down to the last detail. Clear communication, updates along the way and very pleasant to work with on the shoot days themselves. Whether it’s a corporate film or a project with a more creative angle, you’re in good hands with Justin!
reviews.name: Danny
reviews.ctx: Absent Chronicles, on Trustpilot, translated from Dutch

reviews.text: Justin thinks along with you from concept all the way to the shoot and the edit. Great to work with. Someone who always goes that extra step! Super, Justin.
